verdicts.reason: The two layouts are nearly identical. In both, the can is shrunk into the green circle, the ~9px body copy is barely readable and sits on the peach circle, and the gap between the logo and the headline feels arbitrary. A's headline runs almost to the right edge with very little margin and crowds the CTA row. B scales the headline down and enlarges the CTA, which gives cleaner margins and a better-grouped bottom row, but leaves dead space to the right of the headline and weakens the headline's dominance a little.
